name: Lying Spinal Twist
steps: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides, knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your knees together and guide them gently to one side while keeping your opposite shoulder near the floor.
Hold the stretch while breathing evenly, then draw your knees through center and hold on the other side.
Continue alternating holds, then return to center and lower both feet.
tips: Keep your opposite shoulder blade resting near the floor even if your knees do not touch the ground.
Move smoothly and let gravity deepen the twist rather than forcing your lower back.
